name: Brownfield Codebase Update & Maintenance Workflow
description: Enterprise standard operating procedure for updating existing codebases — impact analysis, baseline test verification, backward-compatible contract evolution, surgical implementation, full regression testing, git diff auditing, and semantic versioning.

phases.name: Impact Analysis & Baseline Verification
phases.description: Inspect existing codebase, verify that existing tests pass (baseline), map affected files and downstream dependencies.

phases.name: Contract Evolution & Compatibility Assessment
phases.description: Ensure proposed changes maintain backward compatibility. If breaking, define versioning (/v2) and migration path.

phases.name: Surgical Parallel Implementation
phases.description: Apply minimal, surgical edits to existing files. Preserve comments, docstrings, formatting, and unrelated logic. No destructive rewrites.

phases.name: Full Regression Testing & Verification
phases.description: Run the entire regression test suite (all existing tests + new tests). Enforce zero regressions on pre-existing capabilities.

phases.name: Git Diff Code Review & Security Delta Audit
phases.description: Review git diff against base branch for unintended side effects, secret leakage, OWASP regressions, and scope creep.

phases.name: SemVer Bump, Changelog & Release
phases.description: Update CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog format: Added, Changed, Fixed), bump semantic version (PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR), and produce release report.
